# MP Sole®

> MP Sole® is a footwear sole manufacturer based in Karachi, Pakistan, producing P.U Gents, Ladies Jelly, TR and Medicated shoe soles for footwear brands, manufacturers, wholesalers and B2B buyers.

## Official Website
- https://mpsolemanufacture.com/

## Company
- Name: MP Sole®
- Founded: 1990
- Location: Karachi, Pakistan
- Industry: Footwear Sole Manufacturing

- Home: https://mpsolemanufacture.com/

- Blog: https://mpsolemanufacture.com/blog
- B2B Quote / Contact: https://mpsolemanufacture.com/contact

## Sole Categories
- P.U Gents Sole: https://mpsolemanufacture.com/sole-types/pu-sole-gents
- Ladies Jelly Sole: https://mpsolemanufacture.com/sole-types/ladies-jelly-sole
- TR Sole: https://mpsolemanufacture.com/sole-types/tr-sole
- Medicated Sole: https://mpsolemanufacture.com/sole-types/medicated-sole

## Manufacturing Topics
- Shoe sole manufacturing
- P.U sole manufacturing
- TR sole manufacturing
- Ladies Jelly sole manufacturing
- Medicated sole manufacturing
- Custom shoe sole development
- Custom mold tooling
- B2B and wholesale sole production
